text: The OMR Automotive Group is a private Italian group founded in 1919 that makes automotive and industrial vehicle components, with 16 plants across six countries.
short: OMR Automotive Group is a private Italian components group founded in 1919.

source.name: Ferrari – OMR Team Partner page
source.quote: The OMR Automotive Group, founded in 1919, is an Italian leader in automotive and industrial vehicle components.
